tips: Use Seedance 2.0 to animate AI-generated images (e.g., from Seedream/Muse Image/GPT-Image-2) into a short “AI eye-drop warp” video.

en.content:
Use Seedance 2.0 to animate AI-generated images (e.g., from Seedream/Muse Image/GPT-Image-2) into a short “AI eye-drop warp” video.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
#AI eye-drop warp
This time, it’s Jiuzhaigou 🇨🇳

Image generation: Seedream, GPT-Image-2
Video generation: Seedance 2.0

This video is free to copy and use♪
1. Put in eye drops
2. Shout, “It’s here!”
3. At any location you like, say “Welcome to ○○”
Apparently that’s the idea 😂 https://t.co/72EhfcLE7J
